Borrowed Knees.name: Borrowed Knees
Borrowed Knees.description: The user grows thin strips of wood from their palms down the outsides of a willing person's legs. For five minutes the user walks beside them, keeping the wood soft at each bending knee and locking the grain along the leg that bears weight. A person whose legs give way can stand, take steps and lower themselves into a seat. The user must keep both palms on the person's hips and match each step. Breaking contact cuts the strips free and they soften at once. Strain: severe.
